component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.signature.standin
component.documentation: The stand-in provider, for development and demonstration servers: it sends to the stand-in e-signature service in the add-on's demo folder, which signs nothing for real. No vendor is chosen (decision H). Registered, and inert: a server uses it only when its nuxeo.conf sets nuxeo.agentic.signature.provider=standin and the stand-in's address, API key and callback secret (the add-on's README).
